meals.note: Ludia sits every Sunday until Support 3. Esmeralda short of 3? She takes Lysander's seat. Lysander not in Dagsion yet? Seat Jasmine.

gifts.note: Nothing they like is buyable yet: meals carry them

weekly.text: The Theater opens at Renown 7 (usually late Ch 8, often Ch 9)
detail: Whether Stage Shows raise Support is unknown.

missables.text: Deliver the Sealed Letter from the [[place:Unmanned Storehouse]]: pick For the Empire's Safety
missables.lose: The other branch and its follow-up quest
missables.recover: The other chain on another route

options.gives: Specialty License (Esmeralda), 200 Renown; Flamma Smugglers in Ch 10
1,000G, 30 Renown; a chain that ends in the Haze Badge (Ch 11)

detail: Its Specialty License is Esmeralda's Armored Knight (Ch 8 at Lv 20, else Ch 9 week 1).
Listed due 9/19, but 9/19 falls in the gap between Ch 9 and Ch 10: 9/1 is the real deadline.

override.text: Armored Knight on the Sealed Letter License once she is Lv 20; else Ch 9 week 1
Priest at Lv 20: White Magic C from the manual, dungeon heals and Mage weeks
Armored Knight now if Lv 20 slipped past Ch 7

barter.for: Inyoni, held for her Ch 9 recruit

assign.why: Near the start of this map; his Ch 11 undead answer

buy.text: Dagsion Armorer: a [[item:Wooden Sword]] (300G) for Ludia's late Ch 8 join

note.text: Blacksmith: Ludia's [[item:Wooden Sword +5]] the day she joins (Smithing Stone)

recruits.action: Once Support 3 and Renown 7 land, take her short quest, go to the marker, report back
detail: She joins at about Lv 15: hand her the stored Killing Edge, Flyssa and Sea-Spirit Charm.
Bench sword: Myrmidon at Lv 20 (late Ch 9), Arena Infantry with Inyoni from Ch 9.
EXP: Cindered Road Cave now, then every Ch 9 dungeon party.

prep.text: Buy 10 Dates on the Ch 9 Baina trip for Halvin's recruit
detail: [[place:Baina Oasis]] sells them (30G each, 10 in stock). Huge Hairy Beasts pays 2.
Also [[place:Sandflow Road]] or the [[place:Tarvos]] farming spot (Renown 6).

prep.text: Inyoni appears about 7/10: recruit her in Ch 9 week 1 (Renown 7, 3,000G); keep the gold aside

sub.note: White-Magic Manual for Catania: White B for Physic by Ch 11

detail: Jyoppa pay two Archer's Ring barters: Buccar's (Ch 9) and Halvin's (Ch 11).

explore.text: Run [[place:Cindered Road Cave]] (Lv 22, Solidus): Esmeralda, Jasmine, Fianna, Ludia + one carry
detail: Flying Manual for Catania, a [[item:Concoction]] and a [[item:Conflagrant Gem]]: the Giant's Ring fallback.
Esmeralda sits the battle: this cave is her Lv 20 push. Ludia joins the party once recruited.

tips.text: A long-range shot fires every third turn: keep HP high and check its range with ZL
Pack: Leda a [[item:Dew of Protection]] for that shot; Dadao his [[item:Iron Axe +3]] (no armor)
Grab the [[item:Cleansing Blade]] near the start for Guzran; Esmeralda sits if guests fill slots
Talimun has Heal: use him to top up the front
